segments.an7.67:1.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ [suparikkhittaṃ (ka.)] hoti, catunnañca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:1.2: Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
segments.an7.67:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā [gambhīranemi (ka.)] sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī [asampavedhi (sī. syā.)].
segments.an7.67:2.3: Iminā paṭhamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare parikhā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca.
segments.an7.67:3.2: Iminā dutiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca.
segments.an7.67:4.2: Iminā tatiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañceva jevanikañca [jevaniyañca (sī. aṭṭha.)].
segments.an7.67:5.2: Iminā catutthena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyathidaṃ – hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.
segments.an7.67:6.3: Iminā pañcamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
segments.an7.67:7.2: Iminā chaṭṭhena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca.
segments.an7.67:8.2: Iminā sattamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:9.1: “Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī?
segments.an7.67:9.2: Idha, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:12.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, seyyathidaṃ – sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:12.3: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:13.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ imehi sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti, imesañca catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:13.2: Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
segments.an7.67:13.3: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yato ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:13.4: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato.
segments.an7.67:14.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:14.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ ‘itipi so … pe … buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an7.67:14.4: Saddhesiko, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:15.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare parikkhā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:15.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
segments.an7.67:15.3: Hirīparikkho kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:16.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:16.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
segments.an7.67:16.3: Ottappapariyāyapatho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:17.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañceva jevanikañca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:17.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti … pe … diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
segments.an7.67:17.3: Sutāvudho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:18.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyathidaṃ – hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:18.3: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.an7.67:18.4: Vīriyabalakāyo, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:19.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:19.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
segments.an7.67:19.3: Satidovāriko, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:20.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:20.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
segments.an7.67:20.3: Paññāvāsanalepanasampanno, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
segments.an7.67:21.1: “Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī?
segments.an7.67:21.2: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:21.3: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
segments.an7.67:22.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:22.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
segments.an7.67:23.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:23.2: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako pītiyā ca virāgā … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
segments.an7.67:24.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, seyyathidaṃ – sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
segments.an7.67:24.3: Evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
segments.an7.67:24.5: Imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:25.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an7.67:25.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato”ti.

lines: Majjhimadesanagarassa pana rakkhākiccaṃ natthi, tena taṃ na gahitaṃ.
Taṃ panetaṃ esikāthambhaṃ iṭṭhakāhi vā karonti silāhi vā khadirādīhi vā sārarukkhehi.
Taṃ nagaraguttatthāya karontā bahinagare karonti, alaṅkāratthāya karontā antonagare.
Taṃ iṭṭhakāmayaṃ karontā mahantaṃ āvāṭaṃ katvā cayaṃ cinitvā upari aṭṭhaṃsaṃ katvā sudhāya limpanti.
Yadā hatthinā dantehi abhihato na calati, tadā sulitto nāma hoti.
Te sace aṭṭha ratanā honti, caturatanamattaṃ āvāṭe pavisati, caturatanamattaṃ upari hoti.
Sabbesañhi upaḍḍhaṃ heṭṭhā hoti, upaḍḍhaṃ upari.
Te gomuttavaṅkā honti, tena tesaṃ antare padaramayaṃ katvā kammaṃ kātuṃ sakkā hoti, te pana katacittakammā paggahitaddhajāva honti.
Anupariyāyapathoti anto pākārassa pākārena saddhiṃ gato mahāpatho, yattha ṭhitā bahipākāre ṭhitehi saddhiṃ yujjhanti.
Celakāti ye yuddhe jayaddhajaṃ gahetvā purato gacchanti.
Calakāti “idha rañño ṭhānaṃ hotu, idha asukamahāmattassā”ti evaṃ senābyūhakārakā.
Te kira parasenaṃ pavisitvā piṇḍapiṇḍamiva chetvā chetvā dayanti, uppatitvā niggacchantīti attho.
Ye vā saṅgāmamajjhe yodhānaṃ bhattapānīyaṃ gahetvā pavisanti, tesampetaṃ nāmaṃ.
Pakkhandinoti ye “kassa sīsaṃ vā āvudhaṃ vā āharāmā”ti vatvā “asukassā”ti vuttā saṅgāmaṃ pakkhanditvā tadeva āharanti, ime pakkhandantīti pakkhandino.
Mahānāgā viya mahānāgā, hatthiādīsupi abhimukhaṃ āgacchantesu anivattiyayodhānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Sūrāti ekasūrā, ye sajālikāpi savammikāpi samuddaṃ tarituṃ sakkonti.
Cammayodhinoti ye cammakañcukaṃ vā pavisitvā saraparittāṇacammaṃ vā gahetvā yujjhanti.
Bahi vā khāṇupākārasaṅkhātena vāsanena ghanamaṭṭhena ca sudhālepena sampanno puṇṇaghaṭapantiṃ dassetvā katacittakammapaggahitaddhajo.

Tiṇakaṭṭhodakanti hatthiassādīnaṃ ghāsatthāya gehānañca chādanatthāya āharitvā bahūsu ṭhānesu ṭhapitatiṇañca, gehakaraṇapacanādīnaṃ atthāya āharitvā ṭhapitakaṭṭhañca, yantehi pavesetvā pokkharaṇīsu ṭhapitaudakañca.
Sannicitaṃ hotīti paṭikacceva anekesu ṭhānesu suṭṭhu nicitaṃ hoti.

Idāni yasmā tathāgatassa nagare kammaṃ nāma natthi, nagarasadisaṃ pana ariyasāvakaṃ, nagaraparikkhārasadise ca satta dhamme, catuāhārasadisāni ca cattāri jhānāni dassetvā ekādasasu ṭhānesu arahattaṃ pakkhipitvā desanaṃ vinivaṭṭessāmīti ayaṃ upamā ābhatā.
Tasmā taṃ desanaṃ pakāsetuṃ idaṃ evameva khotiādi āraddhaṃ.
Tattha dānasīlādīnaṃ phalaṃ saddahitvā dānādipuññakaraṇe saddhā okappanasaddhā nāma.
“Sampakkhandanalakkhaṇā ca, mahārāja, saddhā sampasādanalakkhaṇā cā”ti (mi. pa.2.1.10) hi vacanato idaṃ saddhāya lakkhaṇaṃ nāma.
Sīlavantānaṃ dassanakāmo hotī”tiādinā (a. ni.3.42) nayena vuttaṃ pana saddhāya nimittaṃ nāma.
“Ko cāhāro saddhāya, saddhammassavanantissa vacanīyan”ti (a. ni.10.61) ayaṃ panassā āhāro nāma.
“Saddhāpabbajitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ayaṃ anudhammo hoti, yaṃ rūpe nibbidābahulo viharissatī”ti ayamassa anudhammo nāma.
“Saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi”(su. ni.77; saṃ. ni.1.197).
Upekhāsetadantavā”tiādīsu pana suttesu etissā baddhabhattapuṭādisarikkhatāya anekasarasatā bhagavatā pakāsitā.
Imasmiṃ pana nagaropamasuttante esā acalasuppatiṭṭhitatāya esikāthambhasadisā katvā dassitā.
Saddhesikoti saddhaṃ esikāthambhaṃ katvā ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahatīti iminā nayena sabbapadesu yojanā kātabbā.
Apicettha hirottappehi tīsu dvāresu saṃvaro sampajjati, so catupārisuddhisīlaṃ hoti.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte ekādasasu ṭhānesu arahattaṃ pakkhipitvā desanāya kūṭaṃ gahitanti veditabbaṃ.
“Ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhānakkho cakkavīriyo”tiādīsu (saṃ. ni.5.4) viya alaṅkāravacano parikkhārasaddoti āha “nagarālaṅkārehi alaṅkatan”ti.
Nemaṃ vuccati thambhādīhi anupatabhūmippadesoti āha “gambhīraāvāṭā”ti, gambhīraṃ bhūmiṃ anuppaviṭṭhāti attho.
Anupariyāyeti etenāti anupariyāyo, soyeva pathoti anupariyāyapatho, parito pākārassa anuyāyamaggo.
Hatthiṃ ārohanti ārohāpayanti cāti hatthārohā (dī. ni. ṭī.1.163).
Yena hi payogena puriso hatthino ārohanayoggo hoti, hatthissa taṃ payogaṃ vidhāyantānaṃ sabbesampetesaṃ gahaṇaṃ.
Tattha hatthācariyā nāma ye hatthino hatthārohakānañca sikkhāpakā.
Dhanuṃ gaṇhanti gaṇhāpenti cāti dhanuggahā, issāsā dhanusippassa sikkhāpakā ca.
Celena celapaṭākāya yuddhe akanti gacchantīti celakāti āha –
Yathā tathā ṭhite senike brūhakaraṇavasena tato tato calayanti uccālentīti calakā.
Sakuṇagghiādayo viya maṃsapiṇḍaṃ parasenāsamūhaṃ sāhasikamahāyodhatāya chetvā chetvā dayanti uppatitvā gacchantīti piṇḍadāyakā.
Dutiyavikappe piṇḍe dayanti janasammadde uppatantā viya gacchantīti piṇḍadāyakāti attho veditabbo.
Pakkhandantīti attano vīrasūrabhāvena asajjamānā parasenaṃ anupavisantīti attho.
Ekasūrāti ekākisūrā attano sūrabhāveneva ekākino hutvā yujjhanakā.
Saddhā bandhati pātheyyanti saddhā nāmāyaṃ sattassa maraṇavasena mahāpathaṃ saṃvajato mahākantāraṃ paṭipajjato mahāviduggaṃ pakkhandato pātheyyapuṭaṃ bandhati, sambalaṃ vissajjetīti attho.
Saddhañhi uppādetvā dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ rakkhati, uposathakammaṃ karoti.
Issariye hi abhimukhībhūte thalatopi jalatopi bhogā āgacchantiyeva.
Saddhā dutiyā purisassa hotīti purisassa devaloke, manussaloke ceva nibbānañca gacchantassa saddhā dutiyā hoti, sahāyakiccaṃ sādheti.
